title: 第5章 女友背叛第6章 谁打的他
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
宋萌萌摇了摇头，说：“这边已经没有了，不过汕市那边还有一个大型的赌石市场，规模比这里大很多，原石也更多。”
陈阳脸上露出犹豫的神色，问：“汕市多远？开车要多久？”
“也不是很远。”宋萌萌说，“开车过去也就一两个时辰，你要是想去，我现在就带你去，反正我也没事。”
陈阳在心里盘算着：去要两个时辰，回来又要两个时辰，加上赌石的时间，等他们回来，估计就到晚上了。
宋萌萌和李恒昨天才刚结婚，自己就带着人家的新婚妻子跑一整天，传出去不好，而且也对不起李恒这个发小。
想到这里，他心里越发觉得不妥。
宋萌萌看出了他的顾虑，笑着打趣道：“陈阳，你是不是怕李恒吃醋啊？怕他误会我们？”
陈阳有些不好意思地笑了笑，坦诚说：“嫂子，恒哥倒是不会误会我们，只是你们昨天才刚结婚，正是该好好相处的时候，我这样带你出来跑一天，不太好吧？”
宋萌萌闻言，当即伸手抱住陈阳的胳膊，语气随意又带着几分娇俏：“我都不怕，你还怕什么？
他昨晚喝得烂醉，现在还在睡觉呢，等我们回去，他都不一定醒呢。
走，快上车，我现在就带你去！”
陈阳看着她热情的模样，又想到自己还差五十多万就能凑够100万，最终还是点了点头：“那行吧，不过路途远，我来开车吧，嫂子，你坐副驾驶休息。”
宋萌萌笑着点了点头：“行，那我给你指路。”
两人交换位置，陈阳坐进驾驶座，宋萌萌则坐到了副驾驶。
她今天穿了一条浅色的短裙，刚一坐下，两条白皙纤细的大腿就露了出来，腿上还穿着一层薄如蝉翼的肉色丝袜，勾勒出流畅细腻的线条，肌肤隐隐可见，格外诱人。
配上她那张娇俏的娃娃脸与硕大的上围，一时显得既有少女的灵动，又有成熟女人的妩媚。
陈阳心头不由一热，心跳微微加速，连忙移开目光，不敢再多看，强压住心底的异样，发动车子，朝着汕市的方向开去。
一整天下来，两人又来回跑了三趟赌石摊，每一次陈阳都凭借透视眼精准选中藏有翡翠的原石，转手就能赚一大笔。
等他们开车回来时，已经是晚上8点多钟。
天色早已暗了下来，街道两旁亮起路灯。

陈阳算了一下，一整天下来，加上之前的钱，他一共赚了132万，远远超出了自己100万的目标。
他心里一时喜不自胜，当即在一个路边让开车的宋萌萌停下车，从包里拿出10万块现金，递给她。
“嫂子，这10万块你拿着。”陈阳笑着说，“其中1万块是还你们的，剩下的9万块，是给你的带路费，谢谢你陪我跑了一天。”
宋萌萌看着手里的钱，脸上乐开了花，眉眼弯弯，“陈阳，谢谢，那嫂子我就不跟你客气了。”
“嗯嗯，嫂子不客气。”陈阳笑说。
宋萌萌没想今天大赚了9万，一时都笑得合不拢嘴。
当下，不管陈阳怎么说，她都执意要把陈阳送到他和唐欣悦租住的小区楼下。
一会，车子稳稳停在凤阳小区楼下。
陈阳解开安全带，侧头看向身旁的宋萌萌，神色变得郑重起来，语气诚恳：“嫂子，今天赌石的事，你可千万别往外乱说，我怕太多人知道了，会给我带来麻烦。”
宋萌萌眨了眨灵动的眼睛，脸上带着几分疑惑，问：“那李恒呢？他是你发小，要不要告诉他？”
content_en:
Song Mengmeng shook her head and said: "There is no more here, but there is a large stone gambling market in Shantou City. The scale is much larger than here, and there are more rough stones."
Chen Yang looked hesitant on his face and asked, "How far is Shantou? How long does it take to drive?"
"It's not very far." Song Mengmeng said, "It only takes an hour or two to drive there. If you want to go, I will take you there now. Anyway, I'm fine."
Chen Yang was thinking in his mind: It would take two hours to go, and another two hours to come back. Plus the time spent gambling on stones, it would probably be evening by the time they came back.
Song Mengmeng and Li Heng just got married yesterday, and he took his newlywed wife around all day long. It would not be good for the news to spread, and it would also be a pity for Li Heng, a young man.
Thinking of this, he felt more and more wrong.
Song Mengmeng noticed his concerns and joked with a smile: "Chen Yang, are you afraid that Li Heng will be jealous? Are you afraid that he will misunderstand us?"
Chen Yang smiled sheepishly and said frankly: "Sister-in-law, Brother Heng won't misunderstand us. It's just that you just got married yesterday and it's time to get along well. Isn't it okay for me to take you out for a day out like this?"
When Song Mengmeng heard this, she immediately reached out and hugged Chen Yang's arm, her tone casual and a bit coquettish: "I'm not afraid, so what are you afraid of?
He was very drunk last night and is still sleeping. When we go back, he may not wake up.
Come on, get in the car, I'll take you there now! "
Chen Yang looked at her enthusiastic look and thought that he still had more than 500,000 to collect 1 million. Finally, he nodded: "Okay, but it's a long way. I'll drive. Sister-in-law, you sit in the passenger seat and rest."
Song Mengmeng smiled and nodded: "Okay, then I will show you the way."
The two exchanged positions, with Chen Yang sitting in the driver's seat and Song Mengmeng sitting in the passenger seat.
She wore a light-colored short skirt today. As soon as she sat down, her two fair and slender thighs were exposed. She was also wearing a layer of flesh-colored stockings as thin as cicada wings, which outlined smooth and delicate lines. Her skin was faintly visible, which was particularly attractive.
Coupled with her cute baby face and huge bust, she seemed to have the agility of a girl and the charm of a mature woman.
Chen Yang's heart couldn't help but feel hot, and his heartbeat accelerated slightly. He quickly looked away, not daring to look any further. He suppressed the strangeness in his heart, started the car, and drove towards Shantou City.
Throughout the whole day, the two of them went back and forth to the stone betting stall three more times. Each time, Chen Yang relied on his clairvoyance to accurately select the rough jadeite, and he made a lot of money by changing hands.
By the time they drove back, it was already past 8 p.m.
It had already darkened, and street lights were on on both sides of the street.
Chen Yang calculated that after a whole day, including the previous money, he made a total of 1.32 million, far exceeding his goal of 1 million.
He was so happy that he immediately asked Song Mengmeng, who was driving, to stop the car at a roadside, took out 100,000 yuan in cash from his bag and handed it to her.
"Sister-in-law, take this 100,000 yuan." Chen Yang said with a smile, "10,000 yuan is for you, and the remaining 90,000 yuan is for your traveling expenses. Thank you for running with me for a day."
Song Mengmeng looked at the money in her hand, her face was happy, her eyebrows were crescent, "Chen Yang, thank you, sister-in-law, I won't be polite to you."
"Yeah, sister-in-law, you're welcome." Chen Yang said with a smile.
Song Mengmeng didn't expect to make a huge profit of 90,000 yuan today, and she was laughing from ear to ear.
At the moment, no matter what Chen Yang said, she insisted on sending Chen Yang downstairs to the community where he and Tang Xinyue rented.
After a while, the car stopped steadily downstairs in Fengyang Community.
Chen Yang unbuckled his seat belt and looked sideways at Song Mengmeng beside him. His expression became serious and his tone was sincere: "Sister-in-law, please don't talk about the stone gambling today. I'm afraid too many people will know about it and it will cause trouble for me."
Song Mengmeng blinked her lively eyes, her faceWith some confusion, he asked: "What about Li Heng? He is your kid, do you want to tell him?"
